azure.streamanalytics.jobs.title: Streaming jobs, inputs, outputs, transformation and start/stop over ARM
limitations: Jobs, inputs, outputs and the transformation are real ARM resources with validation, and the query is parsed and checked against the job's inputs/outputs; the Created/Running/Stopped/Failed state machine is enforced. On start a small batch query runner executes SELECT/WHERE/GROUP BY/TumblingWindow over a Blob input and writes line-separated JSON to a Blob output. Event Hub / IoT Hub inputs and every non-Blob output (Cosmos DB, SQL, Power BI, ...) fail the start with a clear error: Vyomi has no such streaming data plane. Hopping/Sliding/Session windows, JOINs, UDFs and continuous processing of new events are not supported. There is no console page yet.
